verdict.rationale: Egnyte is a content platform with an API and MCP surface, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for agents. File-sharing permission limits, SSO integration and MCP client access are adjacent features, not credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
